tasks.label: Setup OctoFit Backend
tasks.command: python3 -m venv octofit-tracker/backend/venv && source octofit-tracker/backend/venv/bin/activate && pip install -r octofit-tracker/backend/requirements.txt

tasks.label: Commit and push to build-octofit-app
tasks.command: git checkout build-octofit-app && git add octofit-tracker/ && git commit -m 'Add OctoFit Tracker app structure, virtual environment, and requirements.txt' && git push -u origin build-octofit-app
